# Subagent 18D — Other Major Partners Specialist

**Parent agent:** 18 — Global Power Relations

## Instructions

Study Russia, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Gulf countries and other economically relevant partners.

Answer these research questions:

1. Which partners are major sources of ODA, labour demand (e.g. Korea EPS, Japan SSW) and trade?
